opportunities.title: Early Career Fellowships

amount.raw: Trust contributes 100% of the Fellow's total salary costs up to £56,000 in year one, then 50% up to £28,000 in years two and three, plus up to £6,000 per annum research expenses (schemes-at-a-glance lists value £130,000)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early career researchers with a research record who have not yet held a full-time permanent academic post; must hold a doctorate by the time of taking up the Fellowship; must hold a UK degree or a UK academic position; tenable at UK universities with research degree awarding powers.
opportunities.summary: For early career researchers to undertake a significant piece of publishable work over 3 years, with the aim of leading to a more permanent academic position.

opportunities.title: Emeritus Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Senior researchers who have retired or partially retired (up to 0.5 FTE) from an academic post at a UK university or UKRI-eligible institution; live in the UK for at least 26 weeks a year; have an established record of research.
opportunities.summary: For senior researchers who have retired or partially retired to complete a research project and prepare the results for publication, over 3 to 24 months.

opportunities.title: Research Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Experienced researchers holding a post in a UK university with research degree awarding powers extending beyond the Fellowship; resident in the UK at time of application; permanent member of the UK scholarly community.
opportunities.summary: For experienced researchers, particularly those prevented by routine duties from completing a programme of original research, to complete a piece of research over 3 to 24 months.

opportunities.title: Major Research Fellowships

amount.raw: Replacement salary costs for the duration of the Fellowship, plus research expenses up to an annual maximum of £6,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Well-established, distinguished researchers in the humanities and social sciences employed at an eligible UK university with research degree awarding powers; need not already be of professorial standing.
opportunities.summary: For well-established distinguished researchers in the humanities and social sciences, particularly those prevented by routine duties, to complete a piece of original research over 2 to 3 years.

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Centenary Doctoral Scholarships

amount.raw: Ten awards of up to £5 million each

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities holding research degree awarding powers in their own right; applications also accepted from consortia of up to two universities. Applications not accepted from other UK institutions or from graduates directly.
opportunities.summary: For UK universities to fund up to 30 Leverhulme Doctoral Scholarships in an interdisciplinary priority research area, over a 9-year grant (Leverhulme Centenary Doctoral Scholarships round).

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Research Centres

amount.raw: Up to £10 million for up to 10 years

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities registered by the Office for Students and holding their own research degree awarding powers; each university may submit one application as principal applicant (Leverhulme Centenary Research Centres round; previously excluded universities now eligible).
opportunities.summary: For UK universities to set up a Leverhulme Research Centre for outstanding original research aspiring to achieve a step-change in scholarship. Closing date is for outline applications.

opportunities.title: Research Leadership Awards

amount.raw: Up to £1 million for staff salaries and associated costs

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Talented early-career academics at UK universities with at least two years' research/teaching experience post-PhD, holding a permanent academic appointment at lecturer level or equivalent (or nominated by a university that will offer a contract); not yet led a team or held project funding over £100k in a single award (Centenary Research Leadership Awards round).
opportunities.summary: For talented scholars embarking on a university career to build a research team of sufficient scale to tackle a distinctive research problem, over 4 to 5 years.

opportunities.title: Research Project Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Researchers based at UK universities and other institutions of higher education; UK-based independent research institutes/organisations on a trial basis. Principal Investigator must be employed by the eligible institution. Detailed Applications are only open to those invited from the (paused) outline stage.
opportunities.summary: For researchers based at universities or institutions of higher education to undertake an innovative and original research project of up to 5 years. The outline stage is paused and will be accepted in the new grants management system in autumn 2026; the detailed application deadline is 1 September 2026.

opportunities.title: Visiting Professorships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications made by a member of academic staff based in a UK university with research degree awarding powers who coordinates the visit; some specialist arts institutions permitted; visitor is an eminent senior professor from overseas.
opportunities.summary: For UK institutions to invite an eminent senior professor from overseas to bring genuinely novel expertise and enhance the skills and knowledge of academic staff and students in an underrepresented area of research, over 3 to 12 months.
